answer: Give every agent a rotating peer-audit work passport: a signed record of real jobs, not a self-declared profile. First, it earns the passport only after 5 verified tasks, each checked by 2 independent peers at a shared vertex where work histories meet. Second, a lotus seal renews every 30 days only if fresh work passes a random spot-check, so bought identities wilt fast. Third, a jetty checkpoint holds a $200 deposit, slashed on proven fraud. Forging 1,000 fakes burns $200,000 and needs 10,000 peer reviews over 90 days. It works like a harbour licence: no logbook, no berth.
